superseded_v2_branches.reason: S5 segment purity (2.0%-5.4%) and R3 G2 cross-plane edge recall (10.15%-27.53%) demonstrated that origin-agnostic local greedy linking fails inside 1.43 X0/layer tungsten showers; end-to-end differentiable vertex recentering + GN2 cluster-origin/compatibility auxiliary loss provides direct gradient guidance without brittle hard matching thresholds.

domains.name: D_empty
domains.description: Zero accepted pixel, bar, and tracker response

domains.name: D_pix_contained
domains.description: Pixel-active, no upstream veto, first hit inside pixel depth, transverse CoG inset 15mm, edge energy fraction < 0.25

domains.name: D_scint_contained
domains.description: Not in D_pix_contained, bar-active, no upstream veto, z_first <= 85% target depth, edge energy fraction < 0.30

domains.name: D_partial_or_edge
domains.description: Remaining non-empty events with upstream veto activity, late start, or large lateral leakage

phases.V0: Problem formulation, observable containment conditioning, E_nu<=2.3TeV bias checks, zero-leakage truth sidecar, and zero-training regional calibration replay
phases.V1: B1++ zero-hole sensor matrices, z-aligned stereo backbone, corrected y-z bending sagitta spectrometer kinematics, exact x/y mirror augmentation (16-24 passes)
phases.V2: PinpointFormer with all-retained 16-dim sub-mm cluster moments, 32x32 large-cluster micro-conv, NuGraph2 orthogonal bar nexus, Stage-1/Stage-2 differentiable vertex-anchored polar recentering & IP bias, and ScaledQKNormAttention
phases.V3: FASERCal homoscedastic 4-head event supervision (7-way fine classes + explicit Charm + 3D vertex + kinematics) + ATLAS GN2 pixel-cluster 5-class origin, track/vertex compatibility & full-detector Rel
phases.V4: Dual-regime integration (Pixel topology + Scintillator NOMAD transverse kinematics), DRO/CVaR One-Way Partial-AUC (@1% FPR) tail finetuning, cross-model ensemble, conditional SSL if triggered
phases.V5: 3-seed stability expansion (17, 42, 2026) and one-shot unsealing of Cal-A40k -> Cut-B160k -> Confirm200k with multi-domain Profile-Likelihood significance

promotion_gates.V2_pinpointformer_over_b0: Probe B passed and Pixel-centered BA4 strictly outperforms B0 HGB (55.92%)
promotion_gates.V3_gn2_multitask: Pixel-centered BA4 gain >= +4.0 pp over B0 HGB and measurable charm false-positive reduction
